hls.type: VOD fMP4, shared video with localized mixed audio

musicCredit: 'Helios' by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au

quality.sourcePolicy: Unchanged checked V9 encoded pictures are retained where possible. Changed joins and the credited added archive photographs/films/official visualizations are encoded at 1080p50 without generated detail. Narration is rebuilt per scene, authentic historical speech is retained from checked source audio, and the licensed score is remixed with long crossfades. Original production inputs remain outside the repository in a local application cache.
quality.runtimeFallback: HLS-only HD delivery; full-resolution review MP4s remain local because they exceed the static host per-file limit.
quality.originalMasterPolicy: Rebuilt from retained original source clips, never enlarged from the low-bitrate fallback. Native1080/4K sources and60fps originals are used where retained and traceable; lower-resolution archival footage is upscaled with Lanczos; source frame rates are resampled by selecting/repeating frames. No optical-flow-generated frames or invented archival detail.

narrationAlignment.method: Cross-correlation of each actual delivered AAC paragraph onset against its rendered PCM stock narration; search ±150 ms, maximum allowed error 5 ms.

narrationManifestRole: Current stock narration production manifest; complete audio validated against the delivered HLS.
transitionPolicy: Original source dissolves are retained. Changed entries use short clean fades. Mars, Webb and the closing reflection share one uninterrupted music passage with gentle speech ducking.
